passport.title: Stock price (v2)
passport.description: Stream-type automation: given the name of a public company, it returns its live share price and saves it to history.
passport.author: architect

info.aiSummary: Working v2 "share price" automation: control panel → company recognition → live Yahoo quote → write to the dashboard. Reference E2E example of v2's own runtime.

howItWorks: You name a public company (for example "Apple") in the launch panel.
The automation recognises the company and takes its stock ticker.
By the ticker, the live share price is requested from Yahoo Finance.
If the price is obtained, a row with the date, company, ticker and price is added to the dashboard.
If the company is not recognised or the price is unavailable, the run honestly stops and writes nothing.

nodes.name: If success
nodes.description: The branch taken when the middle produced a result — the flow continues to the output.

info.aiSummary: The success branch: passes the result on to be written. The real gate is the throw in the price node, so only the successful flow reaches here.

function.name: ifSuccess
function.summary: Lets the flow through only when the middle produced a result.
function.accepts: result — the value produced by the middle of the flow.
function.returns: result — the same value, when the branch holds.

nodes.name: If failure
nodes.description: The branch taken when the middle could not produce a result — the flow ends here.

info.aiSummary: The failure branch: a visual dead end. The real failure already stopped the run in the price node, so the function does nothing.

function.name: ifFailure
function.summary: Ends the flow when the middle produced no result.
function.accepts: The failure reported by the middle of the flow.
function.returns: Nothing — a failure branch ends the flow.

info.aiSummary: Map section — build map/route/geocoding automations here. Do NOT rebuild a map renderer, router or geocoder: wire the existing geo capability via the folder door api/geo (op: geocode | matrix | route | optimize) and render with the map component in _components/map/public. Read tools-docs/map.md first. The active map region is chosen by the owner in Admin → Settings → Map settings; this automation only consumes it.
Blank "Main map": created together with the tab, no owner requirements yet.

The automation's tick: how often, in minutes, it looks back at itself. It is needed not by this section but by the calendar — its watcher raises notifications at exactly this rhythm. A disabled schedule means there is no one to remind.
The tab's only schedule: whether it is enabled and with what period. The period is read by the pulse bar and the calendar watcher.
